original_value: Fictional ambient lighting sculpture for indoor décor and event staging. Frosted polycarbonate diffuser, programmable color cycles, silent convection cooling, and USB-C power input. Designed as a tabletop accent light with low-power LED illumination and a warm-to-cool scene mode.
